data.raw_text:
🚨 Traffic Advisory 
A fire has gutted a building (containing timber) in Seeta near Mogas petrol station. @PoliceUg  diverted motorists to alternative routes as firefighting efforts continue.

❌ Area to Avoid
The stretch from Namanve (Coca-Cola area) to Seeta is heavily affected & should be avoided.

➡️ Alternative Routes
From Mukono to Kampala:
Use: Seeta → Sonde → Namugongo → City Centre

From Kampala to Mukono:
Option 1: Northern Bypass → Nalya → Kyaliwajjala → Sonde → Seeta
Option 2: Spear Motors → Bweyogerere → Namanve → Mukono

⚠️ Advisory
Expect delays on these alternative routes.
Follow traffic guidance & drive carefully as emergency teams manage the situation.
Thank You

Here are the top 10 rice puddings: https://t.co/LTPPQ1eCl3

Rice pudding is a forced structural breakdown. You boil hard grains until they surrender their starch, naturally thickening the surrounding liquid into a heavy, dense bind.

Different cultures manipulate this base with absolute precision. Turkiye scorches the surface under intense heat to build Fırın Sütlaç. The Philippines floods the pot with dark cacao to create Champorado. Thailand bypasses dairy entirely, binding the sticky grain with heavy coconut cream and resting it against fresh mango.
